applyTo: "app/**/*.tsx,app/**/*.ts,app/**/*.css"
---

# Frontend conventions

Use React, React Router SPA mode, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS consistently with the existing implementation. Keep the site usable on mobile and when platform services are down.

Pair status colors with readable labels and icons. Use semantic controls, visible focus and accessible names. Preserve filters, service detail context and clear last-checked/stale messaging. Show empty, not-launched, loading and monitoring-failure states honestly.

Verify rendered desktop and mobile layouts and keyboard interaction after UI changes; attach screenshots in the final report. Run type checks before the production build.
